description: This file defines an internal class StorageBatch<TState> implementing ITransactionalStateStorageEvents<TState> for batching and managing transactional storage events in Orleans. It includes methods for preparing, reading, canceling, confirming, committing, and collecting transaction states, along with batch management features like follow-up actions and preconditions.

classes.name: StorageBatch<TState>
classes.description: An internal class that accumulates and manages storage events for batch processing in Orleans transactions.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores the current batch of transaction states into the provided storage, returning a storage identifier.

methods.name: RunFollowUpActions
methods.description: Executes all follow-up actions registered for this batch.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Records a read event with a timestamp, updating metadata accordingly.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares a transaction state with sequence number, transaction ID, timestamp, transaction manager, and state.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels a transaction at a given sequence number.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Confirms a transaction at a given sequence number, removing superseded prepares.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Commits a transaction with specified transaction ID, timestamp, and write participants.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Removes a transaction record from the commit records.

methods.name: FollowUpAction
methods.description: Adds an action to be executed after storing the batch.

methods.name: AddStorePreCondition
methods.description: Adds a precondition check for storing the batch.

methods.name: CheckStorePreConditions
methods.description: Evaluates all store preconditions, returning true if all are satisfied.
